rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to claim Carer's Allowance

rules.description: Applicant must spend at least 35 hours per week caring
rules.reason_if_failed: You must spend at least 35 hours a week caring for someone to be eligible for Carer's Allowance

rules.description: Earnings must be £196 or less per week after tax, NI and expenses
rules.reason_if_failed: Your earnings are too high. You can only earn £196 or less per week (after tax, National Insurance and expenses) to claim Carer's Allowance

rules.description: Applicant must normally live in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for England and Wales residents only. If you live in Scotland, you need to apply for Carer Support Payment instead.

rules.description: Must have been in England, Scotland or Wales for at least 2 of the last 3 years
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been in England, Scotland or Wales for at least 2 of the last 3 years (unless you're a refugee or have humanitarian protection status)

rules.description: Must not be in full-time education
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim Carer's Allowance if you're in full-time education

rules.description: Must not be studying 21 hours or more per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim Carer's Allowance if you're studying for 21 hours a week or more

rules.description: Must not be subject to immigration control
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim Carer's Allowance if you're subject to immigration control

rules.description: Person cared for must receive a qualifying disability benefit
rules.reason_if_failed: The person you care for must be receiving one of the qualifying disability benefits (such as PIP daily living component, DLA middle or highest care rate, or Attendance Allowance)

rules.description: No other carer can be claiming Carer's Allowance or Carer Support Payment for the same person
rules.reason_if_failed: Someone else is already claiming Carer's Allowance or Carer Support Payment for this person. Only one person can claim at a time. If you want to claim, speak to the other carer about changing their benefits.

explanation_template: Carer's Allowance eligibility: {outcome}. You could receive £83.30 per week if eligible, plus automatic National Insurance credits.

edge_cases.description: Applicant receives State Pension of £83.30 or more per week
edge_cases.action: No Carer's Allowance payment will be made, but you'll still get National Insurance credits. If your pension is less than £83.30, you'll get Carer's Allowance to make up the difference.
If your State Pension is more than £83.30 a week, you won't get a Carer's Allowance payment but your Pension Credit will increase instead.
Your Universal Credit payment will be reduced by the amount of your Carer's Allowance, but you may get an extra amount for caring. Report the change on your Universal Credit account.

edge_cases.description: Care recipient receives severe disability premium
edge_cases.action: When you claim Carer's Allowance, the person you care for will usually stop getting the severe disability premium. Contact the agency paying their benefit to confirm the impact.

edge_cases.description: Multiple carers want to claim for the same person and cannot agree
edge_cases.action: Hand off to DWP decision maker to determine who should receive the benefit. Both parties can apply and DWP will decide.

edge_cases.description: Applicant temporarily stops providing care (hospital, respite)
edge_cases.action: You can still get Carer's Allowance during temporary breaks. You must report if you or the person you care for will be in hospital/nursing home for more than 12 weeks, or you stop caring for more than 28 days.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a refugee or has humanitarian protection status
edge_cases.action: Residency duration requirement does not apply. Process application normally.

edge_cases.description: Applicant lives abroad as member of armed forces
edge_cases.action: Still eligible despite living abroad. Verify armed forces status and process application.
